name: Ride909
description: Plays the off-beat 909 Ride Cymbal often heard in techno. Clock-synced: press the pad on Step 1 timing and the Ride hits on the off-beats. Pitch and a sidechain-style effect can be set.

params.name: PITCH
params.detail: 909 Tune (unipolar X): mid = 35 kHz; span ≈−6.1…+9.5 st; each hit locks pitch until it ends

params.name: PUMP
params.detail: Kick sidechain amount (bottom = off, top = near-silent duck)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Drum level attenuator (Audio In always full)

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Soft VCA choke; max = full address envelope (hardware)

params.name: GAIN
params.detail: Ride boost above unity (0 = 0 dB, max ≈ +12 dB); soft-clips when boosted
